checks.name: fixed command shape
checks.detail: Allowed top-level arguments are projectId, verificationId, request and idempotencyKey; UUID scope is checked before constructing the one fixed local HTTP path.

checks.name: frozen parser and command identity
checks.detail: Uses the actual 1.1 verification-result parser. Canonical key binds verification/version, a supplied different key is rejected; no random new submission identity is invented.

checks.name: request-bound authentication
checks.detail: Original authorization/cookie/origin/CSRF headers are captured per request in a WeakMap and forwarded into app.inject; explicit project scope is a header. The existing business route revalidates actor and assigned-verifier rights for first write and replay.

checks.name: DTO and effect boundary
checks.detail: Returns original authenticated business response; the tool does not project a new result or execute an external task.

limitations: Read-only repository review; no API/UI/device or service operation performed for this review.
Author test and live facts remain in their separately hashed evidence; this review adds no business acceptance result.
